messages:
maria (Support Lead): morning team — quick triage snapshot: open queue 28, P1=1 (billing loop), P2=6. Macro suggestions at the end.
jamal (SRE): seeing increased error rate on embeddings service again, approx 5% of requests failing 502s in us-west-2 last 30m. I opened an incident ticket: INC-4721.
olivia: thanks Jamal — is that related to the cache invalidation deploy we did at 02:10?
jamal (SRE): probably. rollout-adapter had a retry bug. I rolled back the adapter at 03:05; errors dropped but still a small tail. digging into logs now.
sam - oncall: the customer escalation (TICKET-8853) just replied — says they keep getting repeated charges. Can someone confirm billing macro applied?
maria (Support Lead): @sam -oncall — I applied billing-refund macro and sent the initial refund. Customer wants the root cause. Tagging @ana for deeper billing trace.
nana (typo) — oops sorry typo, meant ana: on it, pulling transactions for that account now. ETA 20m.
ticket-bot: New ticket added: TICKET-8901 - "Streaming cut mid-response" (priority: P2).
olivia: queue note — please use macro: billing-refund-v2 for refunds (it includes the new refund template). Old macro billing-refund is deprecated.
maria (Support Lead): added a pinned note in the channel with the macro list. If you can't see it ping me.
nana (again typo) — leave that, I will rename myself properly later.
nana (actually ana): quick update — I found duplicate charge caused by webhook retry + idempotency key missing for that merchant integration. Created GH issue ops/merchant-webhook#214. Filing a customer-facing summary to send after we finish internal fix.
jamal (SRE): for the embeddings 502s, workaround: if you hit failures, retry with exponential backoff (max 3). I've updated the triage KB to mention backoff.
olivia: can someone ping eng-runtime for a quick review? @eng-runtime on-call? (cc @jamal)
sam - oncall: pinged eng-runtime on-call (they acknowledged).
maria (Support Lead): blockers: ana needs 1 dev owner for the merchant webhook fix (small patch + migration); jamal needs assistance with kernel logs for embeddings in us-west-2; olivia needs a sanity check on macro messaging for refunds.
nana (ana): assigning eng-owner request to @kevin (via GH assignment). Kevin, if you see this can you take the PR?
kevin (external — not in participants): (reacts :eyes:) — not in thread list, but will take it.
jamal (SRE): marker: I'll keep monitoring error rate and drop another update in 30m.
maria (Support Lead): ok action items: ana drafts customer summary, kevin picks up webhook PR, jamal monitors embeddings, sam keeps the customer updated with billing-refund-v2 macro. If anyone picks up a ticket, drop a quick "taking TICKET-xxxx" message.
olivia: taking TICKET-8901 (streaming cut). I'll triage and post replication steps.
sam - oncall: taking TICKET-8853 (billing escalation) — will send interim note to customer.
maria (Support Lead): tiny macro tweak request: change billing-refund-v2 header to include expected processing time (2–3 business days). @olivia can you update the macro in Zendesk?
olivia: will update now, will post diff briefly.
jamal (SRE): update 30m: embeddings errors now at ~1.2% — still trending down.
maria (Support Lead): thanks. If anything becomes P0 escalate to #incidents and ping me directly. Otherwise next triage check at noon.
nana (ana): note for KB: merchant webhook mitigation steps: add idempotency key + short-term duplicate filter. I'll write a short runbook.
kevin (not listed in participants): noted, starting PR today.
maria (Support Lead): FYI — I've attached the macro snippets in the pinned message: 
```
[billing-refund-v2]
Subject: Refund issued — next steps
Body: Hi {{customer_name}}, we've issued a refund of ${{amount}}. Expect 2-3 business days for card reversal. Root cause: transient webhook duplicate; fix in progress.
```

maria (Support Lead): end of thread — short check-in again at 12:00. :thumbsup:
